graph_meta.name: Northgate Facilities Group - organisation knowledge graph (mock data for candidate test)
graph_meta.description: All data is fictional. Nodes carry id, type, label, source and as_of; facts sit in props. Edges are directed from -> to.

node_types.Site: A location the company runs or serves
node_types.Role: A position in the org chart (declared, may be stale)
node_types.Person: An employee as recorded in HRMS (observed)
node_types.System: An operational system that supplies facts
node_types.Asset: An information, physical or safety-critical asset with C/I/A ratings 1-5
node_types.Process: A business process with an owning role
node_types.MSType: A management-system standard and its certification status
node_types.Obligation: A requirement derived from a regulation or standard
node_types.Control: A control in the control library, with the owner's self-rating
node_types.ControlTest: A dated test result for a control
node_types.ContinuityPlan: A business continuity or disaster recovery plan
node_types.PenaltyRecord: A monthly service-level penalty from CRM
node_types.SupplierSpend: Spend share by supplier from ERP
node_types.TrainingRecord: Training or certification facts from HRMS
node_types.Incident: A logged incident or near miss
node_types.AuditFinding: An internal or certification audit finding
node_types.Signal: An external news, weather, regulator or threat signal (some irrelevant)
node_types.KRI: A key risk indicator with a trigger
node_types.RiskCategory: A category in the risk taxonomy
node_types.ImpactScale: Impact or severity levels and factor definitions
node_types.ApplicabilityRule: Selects the framework for a risk; lower priority number wins
node_types.ControlEffectRule: How control effectiveness is rated and applied
node_types.Band: A matrix band with its score range and required action
node_types.TreatmentRule: Allowed treatment options and their conditions
node_types.Issue: An open issue in the issue register - the input to your pipeline

edge_types.HOLDS: Person -> Role (from org chart, may be stale)
edge_types.RELATES_TO: Issue -> any node it concerns; ContinuityPlan -> Control

props.rule: Effectiveness = the lower of design rating and operating rating. Operating rating comes from the latest ControlTest within 12 months of the run date: pass = Effective, partial = Partially effective, fail = Ineffective. If the latest test is older than 12 months, operating rating is at most Partially effective. If the control has never been tested, it is 'Not evidenced' and treated as Ineffective. The owner's self-rating is the design rating unless a design test says otherwise. A control that only partly covers the risk's assets or causes is at most Partially effective for that risk.

nodes.label: How controls reduce a risk score

props.rule: Preventive controls reduce likelihood (SF-IS: threat or vulnerability). Detective and corrective controls reduce impact. Transfer controls reduce financial impact only. For each dimension, take the strongest applicable control: Effective = 2 levels, Partially effective = 1 level, Ineffective or Not evidenced = 0. If two or more independent controls on the same dimension are Effective, add 1 more level. No dimension can go below 1.

nodes.label: Overall control environment rating for a risk

props.rule: Rate the risk's control environment as Strong (all key controls Effective), Adequate (key preventive control Effective, others Partially effective), Weak (key preventive control Partially effective or worse), or Absent (no applicable control).
